operators.name: abs_forward
semantics: Computes elementwise absolute value: out[i] = |x[i]|, matching torch.abs(x).
Preserves shape, stride, and dtype; does not modify input in-place.
Accepts arbitrary strides; kernel must handle non-contiguous views safely.

operators.name: prelu_forward
semantics: Computes PReLU(x) elementwise with per-channel weight when dim=1 and weight.numel() == C: out[b, c, h, w] = x[b, c, h, w] if x >= 0 else weight[c] * x[b, c, h, w].
When weight.numel() == 1, applies single scalar slope to all elements; here it is 64, so channel-wise.
Matches nn.PReLU(num_parameters=64, use_relu=False); does not apply ReLU variant because use_relu is False.
Preserves shape, stride, and dtype; input and output are distinct tensors.
Elementwise absolute value applied to input tensor x.
Input shape [16, 64, 256, 512], dtype float32; output same shape and dtype.
PReLU activation with per-channel weight of shape [64].
For each element x, output = x if x >= 0 else weight[c] * x, where c is the channel index (assuming input is NCHW).
Here use_relu=False, so the negative slope is learned weight, not fixed 0.
Return the result of PReLU, shape [16, 64, 256, 512], dtype float32, device cuda.
